decision: Launch the installed server bin directly in the packaging test and assert its process is gone after timeout.
rationale: CI run 34020621784 preserved the 4478b980-87e5-8f31-a57e-8c06246e0798 failure: the second server startup gets EADDRINUSE on 127.0.0.1:8799 after the first full test run passed. The npx wrapper does not reliably own and terminate the server child on Linux. Directly launching the manifest-declared installed bin gives spawnSync ownership while preserving the real packaged-server startup assertion and adding process termination assertions.
alternativesRejected: Changing the port alone would hide the leaked process without fixing cleanup.
Skipping the second packaging check or weakening the startup assertion would hide the CI failure.
